title: CharacterIdentityProfile
description: Output of the Character Consistency Engine (Cinematic Intelligence Layer, Phase 7). Created once per character and never regenerated - every shot referencing this character_id reuses this profile instead of re-describing the character from scratch, which is what keeps a character looking like the same person across every shot and scene in a project.

identity.description: The attributes that must not drift between shots.

clothing_default.description: The default/signature outfit, reused unless a shot explicitly calls for a wardrobe change.

expression_bank.description: Reusable named expressions this character can be directed into, each optionally backed by a reference image.

reference_image_ids.description: Asset ids of the Reference Image Engine's character reference package for this character.

consistency_seed.description: Shared seed reused across every shot featuring this character, for engines that support seeding.

lora_binding.description: Prepared, not implemented (Phase 7 scope) - a future per-character LoRA weight, applied by an engine adapter that supports LoRA loading. Absent means no LoRA is bound.

locked.description: Always true - a CharacterIdentityProfile is immutable once created. Corrections create a new version via a repair action, never an in-place mutation of identity fields.
